source.official_agency: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan

employment_purpose.evidence_text: employment as an incidental activity of their holidays

original_text: Participants in the working holiday programmes are allowed to engage in employment as an incidental activity of their holidays for the purpose of supplementing their travel funds. The working holiday programmes participants are strictly prohibited from working at bars, cabarets, nightclubs, gambling establishments and other premises affecting public morals in Japan. If a participant works at such a place, he or she is deemed to violate Immigration Control and Refugee Recognition Act and will face deportation except in case where he or she is deemed to be a victim of human trafficking. It is also to be noted that those who are engaged in having the working holiday programmes participants work at these establishments could face criminal charges for promoting illegal work or human trafficking.
